decision: Use xhigh while selecting and reviewing the exact identity seam, high for implementation, and medium for deterministic regeneration and closure
reason: A wrong C# Dynamic-call decision can generate believable but incorrect output, while the final bootstrap and guard phase requires supervision rather than new semantic design
result: The staged levels were sufficient; max was unnecessary, and medium was restored after semantic review

decision: Make C# choose reflection dispatch from the exact typed local selected for each function
reason: The previous process-wide name/type map could confuse shadowed locals and had to be restored after failures
result: Only the outer Dynamic value and exact Dynamic parameters use __HxRuntime.callField; the nested String value remains an ordinary String receiver

decision: Resolve the legacy class/function objects to one stable typed function identity inside TypedModule
reason: The backend must not correlate typed and rendered work by source position, declaration order, sanitized spelling, or target text
result: The typed owner returns the exact strict module, owning class, and function projection and fails on missing or duplicate stable identities

decision: Read Dynamic only from TyLocalBinding.getType through the function-local projection
reason: Cast text, HxFunctionArg and SVar hints, initializers, and rendered names are not authoritative semantic facts
result: The generated lowering calls getLocalCatalog, getBinding, getType, unwrapNull, and isDynamic; no type-hint parser participates

decision: Share one post-order source-body rewriter between bounded target lowerings
reason: C# and Lua need the same complete traversal without adding another mutable renderer context or duplicating every HxExpr and HxStmt walk
result: All current structural statement and expression forms preserve order, positions, metadata, and child evaluation before the target callback runs

decision: Represent the C# dispatch decision with an internal unsupported-expression marker rather than a valid Haxe identifier
reason: A valid helper-like name could collide with user code and be misread as compiler metadata
result: The marker cannot be produced as a callable identifier by valid source and only the C# renderer interprets it

decision: Delete the C# local-type map and its save, restore, lookup, reset, and audit lifecycle
reason: Exact immutable function projections now carry the required fact, so retaining the name-keyed process state would preserve a competing semantic path
result: The retired symbols are absent from authoritative Haxe, regenerated OCaml, tests, and documentation; classified process-wide declarations fall to 114

decision: Type the C# shadowing fixtures through the real parser and typer
reason: Synthetic source-shaped functions without TyLocalBinding facts would force an unsafe fallback and would not test production behavior
result: The fixtures retain exact projected names and prove main, a main-class helper, and a library/support method each consume their own function projection

decision: Compare direct, repeated, forced-failure, and post-failure output
reason: Removing a reset path is safe only if a failed write cannot affect the next request
result: Entry and support output remain byte-equivalent across successful requests and after an output-directory failure

decision: Regenerate committed OCaml exclusively from authoritative Haxe sources
reason: The native compiler snapshot must contain the exact projection, lowering, structural marker, and hard cut without hand edits
result: Stage0 emit 1130s; copy 0s; sharding 6s; native verification 20s; total 1162s; sampled peak RSS 2955 MiB

decision: Compose focused C#/Lua/source-target tests, typed-boundary and request-state guards, the canonical compiler shard, full bootstrap regeneration, and all repository guards
reason: The change crosses typed identity, target lowering, failed-request isolation, generated-source ownership, and formatting
result: All checks pass; the compiler shard ran 114 commands in 474.816s and the formatter checked 886 Haxe files

decision: Accept the exact C# hard cut after correcting three review findings; no Oracle escalation
reason: The explicit xhigh review found and removed cast-text inference, a redundant main-class name lookup, and a valid-identifier marker collision; the remaining seam is bounded and executable
evidence: stale-state search; forbidden-correlation search; marker-ownership search; generated decision inspection; direct code review
result: No source-position, function-order, sanitized-spelling, target-hint, mutable-map, parsed-body, or cross-target fallback remains in the new decision path

decision: Leave README Goals and North Star progress unchanged
reason: This slice removes unsafe request state and fixes exact C# shadowing behavior but does not add typed-module reuse, enable the server by default, or establish a new supported target route
